description: Pension-only comparison of the legacy High-3 system (2.5 percent per year of service) against the Blended Retirement System (2.0 percent per year) on the same high-3 average basic pay: monthly, annual, and 30-year lifetime differences. Excludes TSP matching, continuation pay, COLA, and taxes. Use when a service member compares the legacy High-3 pension with the Blended Retirement System pension. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive BRS vs High-3 calculator.
